policies.title: Nigerian ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked schedule requires Nigerian visitors to obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nigerian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
The active schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if replaced.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Nigerian ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Nigeria in its advance authorized-visa cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nigerian passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Apply in person before travel; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Nigerian ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's official eVisa service lists Nigeria and issues an approved electronic document by email before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nigerian passport holder using Mongolia's short tourist eVisa route.
Apply and receive the approved electronic document before travel, then carry it for border presentation.
Approval is discretionary and does not guarantee admission; other purposes remain outside scope.
